clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, Grelin Whitebeard watches the Frostmane threat by royal decree. From an isolated camp, he depends on local recruits while Ironforge battles the troggs.

Grelin Whitebeard and his brother Senir came to Coldridge Valley on orders from the Senate of Ironforge and King Magni Bronzebeard. They were sent to assess and quell the threat from the native Frostmane trolls. Ironforge's soldiers are tied up fighting trogg outbreaks across Dun Morogh, leaving the brothers with few supplies. Grelin established a camp in the snowy hills and must rely on local recruits and passing initiates to do the work.

From his camp, Grelin watches the Frostmane tribe pressing south from Coldridge Valley. The trolls grow bolder, raiding beyond their mountain caverns. During one raid, Grik'nir the Cold, a heavily painted troll, slipped into the unattended camp and stole Grelin's field journal of observations. Grelin will not fail the King. He sends travelers into the Frostmane caves to recover his writings and carry his final report to Senir in Kharanos.
